## Template Used

LACDR-ISA - Assay (General) v1.0.0

`r rmarkdown::metadata$title`

## Date (dd-MM-yyyy)

## Description or Purpose

To combine all omics data into an Excel Supplementary Table.

### Data sources

- Figure 1 amines
- Figure 1 metabolite rates - scaled and unscaled
- Figure 1 polar metabolites
- Metadata on metabolite names
- Metadata on samples

### Analysis plan

## Results

### Preparations

#### Load R libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(writexl)
```

#### Custom functions

```{r}
source(here("code/functions/helpers.R"))
```

#### Set input and output directories

Show base path to the project that is used in the analysis.

```{r}
here()
```

Set output data directory and create if it does not exist.

```{r}
datestamp <- get_datestamp()
output_dir <- set_output_dir(here("manuscript", str_glue("Tables_{datestamp}")))
```
### Load metadata

```{r}
cell_line_metadata <- read_csv(here("data/cell_line_metadata.csv"))

dim(cell_line_metadata)
head(cell_line_metadata)
```

```{r}
omics_metadata <- list(
  "metadata amines" = read_tsv(here("data/figure_1", 
                           "m_LC-MS_positive_amines_metabolite_profiling_v2_maf.tsv")),
  "metadata polar metabolomics" = read_tsv(here("data/figure_1",
                                       "m_LC-MS_negative_polar_metabolite_profiling_v2_maf.tsv"))
)
```

### Load data

```{r}
omics_datasets <- list(
  "amines" = read_csv(here("data/figure_1", "amines.csv")) |>
    column_to_rownames("amine_metabolite"),
  "polar metabolomics" = read_csv(here("data/figure_1", "polar.csv")) |>
    column_to_rownames("polar_metabolite"),
  "metabolite rates unscaled" = read_csv(here("data/figure_1", "metabolite_rates_unscaled.csv")) |>
    column_to_rownames("metabolite"),
  "metabolite rates scaled Z-score" = read_csv(here("data/figure_1", "metabolite_rates.csv")) |>
    column_to_rownames("metabolite"),
  "metabolite rates scaled minmax" = read_csv(here("data/figure_2", "metabolite_rates_scaled_minmax.csv")) |>
    column_to_rownames("metabolite")
)
# Keep cell lines measured in all datasets.
(common_cell_lines <- lapply(omics_datasets, colnames) |>
  reduce(intersect))

cell_line_metadata <- cell_line_metadata |>
  filter(cell_line %in% common_cell_lines)

lapply(omics_datasets, dim)
omics_datasets <- lapply(
  omics_datasets,
  function(df) select(df, all_of(common_cell_lines))
)

omics_datasets <- lapply(
  omics_datasets,
  function(df) rownames_to_column(df, "ID")
)
lapply(omics_datasets, dim)
```

### Write omics data to supplementary Table

```{r}
excel_sheets <- c(
  omics_metadata,
  list("metadata cell lines" = cell_line_metadata),
  omics_datasets
)
write_xlsx(excel_sheets, here(output_dir, "Supplementary_Table_1.xlsx"))
```
